author: reek
body: Edge routing algorithms. Computes the path an edge takes between two nodes, accounting for routing mode and node intersection.

author: reek
body: A DiagramNode carries its geometry as Integer (`dn-x`, `dn-width`), and a Vec2 is a pair of Real. So this is the boundary between the two and the conversion is explicit at every crossing rather than implied. The routing arithmetic is all Real, because that is what vec2-new takes and what the caller gets back.

author: reek
body: Named for this chapter rather than `rast-abs`, which is a real function in `Game--Rasterizer` over Integer. This one is Real and nothing outside EdgeRouter calls it.
